batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c M Manhas b BW Hilfenhaus

batting.name: KL Rahul
batting.dismissal: c IC Pandey b DR Smith

batting.name: Y Venugopal Rao
batting.dismissal: c DR Smith b MM Sharma

batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c DA Warner b B Kumar

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c Y Venugopal Rao b I Sharma

batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: c KL Rahul b B Kumar

balls.text: a full ball outside off stump, Sammy can't get under it and so he drives the ball towards wide long off, where Raina keeps it down to just two ...
Sammy sprints through and dives after Karn missed the full ball outside off stump, Dhoni missed the stumps with his underarm throw
nearly in the blockhole, Sammy drives it towards long on, where McCullum is so quick that he cuts off the second run
a slower one but the length was too short, Sammy sat back and waited for it, before unleashing a tremendous pull flat over the midwicket boundary
makes room to hit the ball through the off side but gets an inside edge that takes it through midwicket
hit hard towards long-on for a single
he's mis-hit this in the air towards long-on, Dwayne Smith runs in from the boundary and drops it. Two more to Sunrisers. That was a sitter. Plenty of time, a nice height, it simply popped out.
over cover this time! Karn has clobbered it, getting under a full ball and driving it high and far, into the crowd!
Karn Sharma has hooked Hilfenhaus out of the ground! Tremendous shot. Hilfenhaus banged it in short and Karn just swung hard off the back foot
another slower one, length on off stump, hit down the ground to long off for a single

that's an extremely slow ball on off stump, Sammy begins to wind up but then adjusts in the nick of time to try and cut it, he gets a faint outside edge that takes the ball past off stump and on the bounce to Dhoni
that's extremely wide down leg side, going to have to bowl that again
Sammy has stayed back and whipped a fullish ball fiercely off his pads to the backward square leg boundary, he hit that so powerfully for a one-bounce four
Sammy stays back and pushes a slower ball in front of point
played to deep midwicket for a single
Sammy pulls the ball powerfully towards cow corner, where McCullum attacks the ball swiftly and collects the ball with one hand and fires the throw in to prevent the second. Terrific fielding.
Karn Sharma hooks his first ball towards fine leg, it falls well short of Ashwin

Mohit's bowled another batsman with one of those back-of-the-hand slower balls. Finch was done heaving across the line by the time the ball arrived. Middle stump took a beating. Finch goes without finding high gear
Sammy stays back and tries to pull but mistimes it on the leg side
Sammy lunges for a wide one and carves it down to third man, reaches the fielder on the first bounce
good length outside off stump, Sammy tries to stay back and steer behind point but is beaten
Hilfenhaus misses his length and delivers a full toss, Sammy bashes it right back over his head, one bounce and over the straight boundary
a full ball from round the wicket, Finch tries to drill the ball through midwicket but misses and is hit on the pad
Finch backs away outside leg to make room but Hilfenhaus follows him and cramps him for room with his excellent length, Finch pulls but fails to connect properly
Finch fails to make contact as he tries to nudge the ball through square leg
Sammy gets beaten by one that slides across him, he was looking to defend on the front foot and was beaten outside off
nudged off the pads on the leg side
defended on the off side
wide outside leg again but Finch fails to make proper contact with the sweep, ends up playing it tamely to short fine leg
a rare delivery with width outside off from Ashwin, Finch dabs to fine leg
Finch closes the face too early and gets a leading edge towards cover
Finch misses the sweep after the ball pitches extremely wide outside leg, Ashwin looks surprised that it was called wide, he thought it hit something
driven on the up and straight to mid-off, that's the end of Rao. He made good contact with the shot but did not get enough height on it, the ball traveled flat and dead straight to Dwayne Smith
good length on off and middle, Finch plays with a straight bat an runs the single after the ball passes Mohit
short of a length outside off, Rao steers towards third man
Finch steps out of his crease (Dhoni is standing back) and nudges the ball off his hips in front of square leg
dropped close on the off side for a single
driven on the up through cover

Dhoni appeals for a run out but I think Finch is safe. Rao dropped the ball close on the off side and ran, Finch sprinted through as well. The throw came high to Dhoni who whipped off the bails in a flash
that's bowled down leg side and a wide is called after Rao misses the glance
a full ball outside leg, Finch reaches for it and nudges in front of square
Rao slog sweeps to deep midwicket
nudged off the pads behind square
pitches well outside leg, Finch sweeps but can't beat short fine leg
pitched on leg stump from round the wicket, driven to long on for a single
a full ball on off and middle, Finch backs away towards leg to create driving space and drills the ball powerfully to the cover boundary
driven on the front foot towards deep cover
stays back and cuts the ball late towards third man
defending on the front foot towards point
played with an open face towards third man again
short of a length outside off, cut off the back foot towards third man
that darted into the right-hander from over the wicket, Finch was good enough to dab it out towards cover
worked off the pads towards square leg, Dhoni sprints after the ball himself
bowled with a round arm action and the ball angles down leg side, paddled towards the man at short fine leg
punched off the back foot towards extra cover, the fielder at cover dives to cut off the shot but ends up pushing the ball towards mid-on and concedes a single
swept towards deep backward square leg for a single
nudged off the pads towards square leg
that's full and wide outside off stump, Rao tries to drive but misses. The ball swung away from the right-hander too and beat Dhoni as well!
tries to drive but is beaten

he's smashed that, hit it well, but picked out the fielder on the deep midwicket boundary! The ball was short and Rahul pulled hard, the ball flew flat and straight to Ishwar Pandey, who barely had to move to take the catch
played off the back foot in front of point
played through point, where Raina makes a half stop
straighter line on middle, driven on the front foot through extra cover
worked off the pads towards midwicket
back outside leg stump, Finch nudges behind square
pitches in line with the stumps this time and slides across Finch, who stays back and plays towards point
pitches a long way outside leg, Rahul stays back and works the ball on the leg side
pitches outside leg from round the wicket and hits the pads after Rahul misses the pull
driven through cover for a single
Rahul tries to play a reverse sweep and fails to make proper contact, the ball lobs over Dhoni off the toe of the bat, the orthodox shots were working for him
nudged off the pads through square, Dhoni chases after it
short with some width outside off, Finch waits in his crease and then finds the gap between two men at point with a ferocious cut
defended on the front foot towards the off side
Rahul leans forward and nudges the ball through midwicket
a short ball on the pads, a poor finish, Finch swivels and pulls behind square to find the boundary
worked off the pads through midwicket, where McCullum puts on a great show in the field
in the blockhole, Finch jams his bat down on it and hits it hard into the ground, the ball bounces high over the bowler's head and goes down the ground
length ball around off stump, cut firmly but straight to point
tries to works the ball off his pads but makes no contact
Finch drives and opens the face to steer a length ball behind point
pushed on front of point for another single
nudged on the front foot towards point for a single
whoa! That's on the roof at deep midwicket. Rahul gets down low, winds up and unleashes a powerful slog-sweep to great effect
driven firmly into the covers where the fielder makes a sharp stop
played off the back foot towards deep cover
played on to the off side for a single
defended on the front foot
Finch tries to sweep this line but fails to make contact
a fuller length outside leg from round the wicket, Finch chips it on the leg side
played off the pads in front of square leg
pitches outside leg stump from round the wicket - unattractive line, this is - Finch swats it to short fine leg
played to long on for a single
a slower ball around off stump, Rahul keeps strike by opening the face to steer towards third man
punched crisply off the front foot but can't beat cover
Rahul stays back and dabs a good length ball close on the off side, he wants a single but Finch yells his disapproval
shorter length with just a bit of width, cut hard off the back foot and through the gap between two fielders at point
good length on middle, Rahul stays back and defends on the off side
good length from Mohit first up, from over the wicket, Dhoni is still standing up to the stumps, Rahul stays in his crease and blocks
more easy stuff on the pads, a full toss this time, Finch connects and sends the ball speeding to the fine leg boundary
played on the leg side for a single
defended on the front foot towards cover
good length on middle and leg, Finch stays in his crease and dabs the ball towards midwicket
a poor ball with the keeper standing up, full and on the pads, Finch misses the glance but the ball brushes his pads and runs to the fine leg boundary
Rahul stays in his crease and tucks the ball neatly off his hips towards deep square leg
punched off the back foot towards point
nudged off the pads towards the leg side for a single

a huge appeal for lbw and the umpire gives him out after a while! Hilfenhaus' appeal was long and convincing! That's a shocking decision. The ball pitched short of a length well outside leg stump and struck Warner way too high on the pads too. He tried to force it through midwicket and missed. Warner looks quite bewildered at the decision and has every right to be. He was off his toes when the ball hit the top of his pad. Not out on every count.
a fullish ball on the pads but Warner misses out, tried to flick it but did not make contact
he's tried that shot again and he's gone! Dhawan swivelled to pull a short of a length delivery and hit it straight to Mithun Manhas at midwicket. Once again he was cramped for room
short of a length and there's no room to work with for Dhawan as he tries to pull, ends up playing a short arm jab that doesn't beat midwicket
a fuller ball on middle and off, Dhawan comes forward and drives towards wide mid-off
Dhawan pushed at that a bit too early and played it uppishly towards cover
pushed towards cover for a single
this time he stays back, makes room by moving towards leg, and slams a length ball flat over the infield at cover, he hit that really hard
Finch strides down the pitch like Hayden used to do, Pandey sees him coming and shortens the length and denies him room, Finch defends
good length on leg and middle, cramping Dhawan for room, he plays it close on the leg side and runs, there's a direct hit at the bowler's end but Dhawan is safe
length ball on the pads, glanced off the back foot behind square
steered to third man for a single
too short and there's width too, Dhawan cashes in with a fierce cut off the back foot, he hit that so hard it bounced over the fielder at point and raced to the boundary
banged in short, Dhawan seems to have been taken by surprise, he is rooted to the crease and managed to pull his gloves out of the line just in time
good length on middle, bending into the left-hander, Dhawan stays in his crease and defends on the leg side
good length on middle, Finch stays in his crease and jams his bat down on the ball, closing the face a touch to play the ball between square leg and midwicket
that's it. All over. Dhoni slams a full toss to the square leg boundary. A poor ball, the dew might have had something to do about it.
he's cut that straight to point and Dhoni has set off, it was the googly, there should have been a run out at the bowler's end but the throw was too hard for Mishra to collect and it missed
Dhoni stays back and works the ball to long on, giving Manhas the hot seat.
Manhas manages to get an inside edge on the ball to send it towards fine leg. The fielder cannot prevent the second and so Dhoni will have strike for the final over
that's the second dot ball! Ishant shortens his length and gets it to move away a touch. Manhas swishes without moving his feet and is beaten outside off again
he's bowled the first dot ball. Good length outside off, it holds its line and beats Manhas' tame prod. No footwork

he's been bowled! The length was a bit too full to stay back to. The line was too straight to try and steer towards point. There was a gap between bat and pad and Ishant went straight through it to hit middle stump. the ball actually nipped back into the left-hander, grazed the thigh and then hit the stumps
a full toss from round the wicket, driven to long on for a single
Jadeja steps out but is cramped for room by a short of a length delivery, he manages to get some bat on it to play it on the leg side
once again he fumbles the ball at backward point, allowing the single
poor fielding at point, the ball was cut straight to Karn Sharma but he fumbled it, he's now wiping it furiously with a towel so I think it is pretty wet from the dew
round the wicket into the left-hander, Jadeja drives on the front foot to long off
driven off the back foot to deep cover for a single
Dhoni steps out but is beaten by the length and gets hit on the pad, Jadeja begins to run the leg bye but Bhuvneshwar gets to the ball quickly to prevent it
Jadeja charges but mis-times the shot to long-on, he was looking to go high over midwicket
short of a length on the hips, Jadeja glances to long leg to ensure Steyn ends the game wicketless
short of a length around off, played off the back foot to backward point
Dhoni sprints the single, taking on Finch at mid-off, superb running after pushing the ball slowly to the fielder
good length on off stump, defended back to the bowler
Jadeja jumps across his stumps and works the ball off his pads through square leg
punched off the back foot through cover
good length around off, Jadeja plays it to Sammy, who is standing at gully
caught behind! Faf's gone first ball. He tries to drive away from his body at a good length delivery that seams away. A healthy edge that carries comfortably to the keeper Rahul
Dhoni gets hit on the pad as he tries to work the ball on the leg side, they run a leg bye after the ball goes on the off side

caught at long-off! Warner comes charging in and tumbles after holding a well-judged catch on the run. It was a low full toss and Smith didn't hit it as cleanly as he has been doing all evening. He's all but won CSK the game though
Dhoni moves across and works the ball off his pads through midwicket
driven to long on for a single
defended on the front foot
played to deep midwicket
Dhoni steps out and pushes the ball to long on
swung off the front foot to deep square leg
tossed up outside off stump, Smith gets down on one knee and swipes with tremendous power, slamming the ball far over the long-on boundary
Dhoni - helmetless - nudges off the front foot on the leg side
caught on the sweeper boundary. Raina charges and aims to hit straight but ends up slicing a length ball to Rao. An easy catch. Ishant's front foot is fine too.
played back to the bowler
defended from the crease on the leg side
a short ball down leg side, even Raina can play this easily, swivelling and helping it along to the fine leg boundary
moves back and across to work the ball off the pads in front of square leg
Raina has pressed on to the front foot and punched through the line, the outcome is that a length ball goes flying over the long-on boundary
driven on the front foot to long off for a single
defended to cover on the front foot
worked off the pads on the leg side
nudged on the leg side for a single, Smith begins to run but gets sent back, Mishra sprints to the ball and Smith has to dive to make his ground
that's a long hop and it's been punished. Smith rocks back and pulls the ball easily over deep midwicket
defended on the off side
Smith plays the ball to long on to bring up another half-century ... he's been terrific at the start of the season

Warner is electric at mid-off, he dives full length to cut off a powerfully struck ball, it was nearly past him and he had to leap backwards to his left. There's an overthrow because no one was backing up Warner's throw
moves back and across and nudges the ball towards midwicket
pushed off the front foot towards mid-on for a single
a stunning square drive, a length ball disappears to the point boundary, Smith's timing has been outstanding tonight
Smith mows across the line but gets beaten outside off stump
defended on the front foot
bowled him! The length was too full to cut, the line was too straight to cut, it was the googly too. McCullum went back in a flash but was beaten. The ball hit off and middle stump
up and over, McCullum makes room to hit inside out and drives the ball cleanly over the extra-cover boundary
that's the googly and the batsman just manages to keep it out
Smith drills the ball down the ground and long off and long on almost get into a tangle fielding the ball, Steyn gets it cleanly in the end
cut hard off the back foot to deep point
another full ball on middle and leg, flicked through midwicket for a single
a full ball around off stump, driven to cover for a single
a length ball just outside off, Smith waits in his crease and cuts the ball firmly to third man, Ishant fields
good length on off stump, pushed from the crease towards point
in the blockhole, Smith does well to keep it out
a full ball outside off, McCullum drills it past mid-off but long-on runs across to cut it off, there's a lot of dew on the outfield
McCullum gets down on one knee and sweeps to deep backward square
nudged off the pads towards midwicket
McCullum sweeps to long leg for a single
the googly, McCullum fails to read it and is cramped for room as he goes back to cut, mis-times it
too short, McCullum goes back and pulls the ball hard to find the square leg boundary
tossed up nicely outside off, McCullum tries to drive through cover but gets an inside edge on the leg side
banged in short and Smith has banged it flat and hard over the square leg boundary, a poor ball and Smith's quick hands are on display again
Ishant does well to get down low on his follow through and field the ball after Smith pushed firmly with a straight bat
a short of a length around leg stump, Smith ducks under it
he gets beaten outside off by one that holds its line

how on earth has that carried over the cow corner boundary? Smith checked his shot once he realised it was a slower length ball. There was no follow through at all after he pushed at it on the up. It cleared the boundary comfortably
a length ball outside off stump, Smith swings really hard across the line and inside edges it on to his leg
Smith stays back and punches the ball to long on
hit off the back foot towards long on
played off the back foot through cover
dabbed short of the man at midwicket for a quick run
slides on to the pads, bowled flat and quick, Smith nudges behind square for a single
McCullum strides forward and pushes the ball towards point
McCullum leans forward and clips the ball through square for a single. CSK have done phenomenally well in the Powerplay and are well on course ...
driven hard to long on for a single
pitches outside leg, Smith gets down low and plays a powerful slog sweep, the ball flies just out of reach of Steyn at square leg and races to the boundary
pushed off the back foot to point
misses the slog sweep this time but Smith calls him through for a leg bye
McCullum charges the spinner, makes room by moving outside leg, and smashes the ball over mid-off for a one-bounce four. He got to the pitch nicely
Smith's sent that into the stands beyond long leg, the length was on the shorter side and Smith swiveled and made great contact. Not the best line to bowl when fine leg is in the circle
McCullum swings hard at a short of a length ball once again but mis-times it, Sammy has been placed on the deep midwicket boundary and the ball falls short of him
a length ball around off, McCullum drives on the up off the back foot but mis-times it to cover
a slightly slower delivery and McCullum mis-times the slap off the back foot to cover point
pushed off the front foot towards point

that is some shot! The length was good and the ball came into the right-hander, McCullum stayed back and some how managed to square drive the ball so hard into the ground that it bounced over the fielder at point. He played that inside out almost
played towards midwicket
defended on the leg side off the front foot
defended on the front foot

McCullum steps out and lofts the legspinner straight over his head, the ball seems to be going over the boundary for a one-bounce four but Finch sprints and lunges to snatch the ball just before it passes him
driven towards long on for a single
McCullum leans forward and nudges the ball towards square
nudged off the pads on the leg side
played on the up towards cover point

the fielder on the deep midwicket boundary leaps with one hand outstretched over his head but the ball clears him! It was Rao, and he was not on the edge of the boundary. Steyn had banged it in short and McCullum played a powerful hook. Steyn is unhappy and tells the fielder in no uncertain terms that he should have been right on the boundary. It might have beaten him even if he was
good length and straight, defended off the back foot towards the bowler
a full ball on the pads, Smith fails to connect with the flick and runs another leg bye. Not a very good ball
good length outside off, the ball holds its line and beats Smith's outside edge
that's a bad ball and he's lucky to escape without being hit for four. Bhuvneshwar strayed on to the pads and McCullum's glance went straight to the fielder at short fine leg
strays on to the pads this time, Smith misses the flick but they run a leg bye
defended watchfully on the off side
Smith pulls one that is not that short and gets a bottom edge that misses the stumps and beats the keeper. Lucky break for Smith. That was very close to the stumps
Smith moves forward and pushes a good length ball to mid-on
squared him up with a good length ball that pitched on middle and moved away from the right-hander, McCullum got an outside edge that flew behind point to third man
hit with a lot of power but Warner is in the way at point, Smith has found his timing right away
good length around off, Smith stays in his crease and defends on the off side
a length ball outside off, Smith presses forward and hits on the up through the line, he ends up slicing the ball over cover point. Warner will not be catching up with that
played with an open face to Warner at point
Smith stays in his crease and punches the ball on the up through point, that would have got a lot closer to the boundary it it had not been Warner after it
good length on off and middle, defended with a straight bat back to Steyn
